integrationProposal.stateOwnership: One AnnotationState per document session, outside viewport snapshots, held by the same session owner worker. Keep bounds/content identity and monotonic document session token; pan/zoom passes context without recreating/restoring annotations. For document cancel/token invalidation that retains the current document, use AdvanceSession instead of ReplaceSession; preserve records, bounds and next cursor while invalidating old editor tokens.
integrationProposal.actions: Route flag/mark create/update/delete/cycle and annotation commands through typed AnnotationRequest(version,session,context,action). Capture session in deferred editors; reject StaleSession before reused IDs can affect new trace state. Convert owner cancellation/deadline into AnnotationError::Cancelled/DeadlineReached.
integrationProposal.persistence: On Save intent, obtain bounded insertion-order persistence projection and combine it with the other owner-held view-state fields, including favorites, under current content hash/version checks. The module does not define sidecar JSON shape, path, trace name, bookmark or file removal. Treat persistence cancellation/retry independently from viewport generations so successful user edits are not dropped.
integrationProposal.reveal: Forward AnnotationReveal.range to the existing generic host reveal path/navigation module. Keep target kind/ID for UI association only; do not invent EventKey or Store lookup for annotations. nearest visible endpoints intentionally use the current Swift closed check.
integrationProposal.ffiSdk: Coordinator defines generated versioned fixed-width records (kind/id/time/range/color index/persistent flag and bounded UTF-8 offset+length), request discriminator, version/session token, error code and None/Save intent. Do not expose Rust Vec/String/reference layout. AnnotationState remains private owned data; colorIndex resolves through the already delivered annotation palette.
integrationProposal.validation: Re-run actual 748-state oracle against generated wire/SDK facts, ABI offsets/version and Swift/C# API gates, total owner+projection+encoding budget, stale editor after replacement, cancellation/deadline/retry, persistence format/content mismatch and overlay survival across real pan/zoom; build App and perform native GUI acceptance on main.

limitations: Pure module only. No Store/Engine/cache/SDK/FFI/App/CLI production integration, disk IO, sidecar schema, favorite rules, palette duplication, general reveal/viewport algorithm or completion of AT-RUST-011/macOS acceptance.

New input/retained caps, typed cancellation/deadline errors, ID/color/timestamp checked overflow and monotonically increasing non-wrapping session tokens are new safety boundaries. Trapping or over-budget Swift inputs are not executed as oracle vectors.

The oracle intercepts the unmodified annotation command-selected revealRange argument before generic viewport padding/clamping. Target range is compared; Rust target kind/ID is a new typed field separately checked against the real state/navigation records.

Restoration accepts duplicate/negative IDs and negative flag timestamps that current Swift Codable accepts. First matching ID is edited; all matches are deleted. Negative flag point targets fall back to [0,1), matching Swift. Product host still validates content identity and sidecar compatibility before restore.

Persistence projection includes insertion-order flags and persistent marks only. Its is_empty does not authorize deleting a sidecar that contains favorites; host owns whole view-state persistence decisions.

retained_bytes counts result struct, Vec capacity including String control blocks, and String capacity. Allocator headers, caller input, borrowed sorted reference arrays and transactional temporary copy are excluded; each state/projection is bounded and the host must budget simultaneous owner state/projection/encoding storage.

Atomicity is per apply/restore/projection call: a failed apply/restore does not mutate live state and a failed projection returns no partial projection. This is not a new disk-transaction guarantee; main owns persistence delivery/retry and existing atomic file operations.

Sorting is bounded to 4096 records and checked before/after, not inside sort comparison. Copy/retain/input loops check every 256 records; each <=4096-byte label copy checks both sides. Cancellation/deadline are supplied by the owner callback; the module has no clock.
